questions.question: How many adventurers are in the normal party?
questions.correctExplanation: The normal MarkOfChaos adventuring party has 6 adventurers.
questions.wrongExplanation: The normal party has 6 adventurers.

questions.question: Who is the Party Leader?
answers: The person assigned as Party Leader before entering the dungeon
questions.wrongExplanation: The Party Leader is assigned before entering the dungeon. It is not automatically the most experienced player.
questions.correctExplanation: The Party Leader is assigned before entering the dungeon.

questions.question: Who is second-in-command?
questions.correctExplanation: The Knight is the second-in-command.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Knight is the second-in-command, not the Rogue.

questions.question: Who normally fills the Scout role?
questions.correctExplanation: The Rogue normally fills the Scout role.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Rogue normally fills the Scout role.

questions.question: Who monitors the party's health bars?
questions.correctExplanation: The Healer watches the party's health bars.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Healer monitors the party's health bars.

questions.question: Who should monitor the party's MP?
questions.correctExplanation: The Mage monitors the party's MP.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Mage is responsible for monitoring the party's MP.

questions.question: Who does the most damage?
answers: The person in the Rear Guard who draws the monster back
questions.correctExplanation: The Rear Guard member draws the monster all the way back so the party can attack it safely.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Rear Guard member draws the monster back so the rest of the party can attack it safely.

questions.question: Who is the Dark Magic Specialist?
questions.correctExplanation: The Sorcerer is the Dark Magic Specialist.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Sorcerer is the Dark Magic Specialist.

questions.question: Who controls movement out of combat?
questions.correctExplanation: The Scout position controls movement when the party is out of combat.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Scout position controls movement out of combat.

questions.question: Who controls movement during combat?
questions.correctExplanation: The Center position controls movement during combat.
questions.wrongExplanation: During combat, the Center position controls movement.

questions.question: Can any party member be in the Center?
questions.correctExplanation: The Center is a position, not a fixed class. Any party member can be in the Center.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Center is a position, not a fixed class. Any party member can fill it.

questions.question: Should the party stay together in a dungeon?
questions.correctExplanation: The party stays together so members can protect and support each other.
questions.wrongExplanation: The party should stay together rather than exploring alone.

questions.question: Should one player rush ahead alone?
questions.correctExplanation: Players should not rush ahead alone because it can separate them from the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: Players should not rush ahead alone.

questions.question: What should you do if you become separated?
answers: Keep going they will catch up
questions.correctExplanation: Stop and regroup with the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should stop and regroup instead of continuing alone.

questions.question: Who watches for danger ahead?
questions.correctExplanation: The Scout watches ahead for danger.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Scout is responsible for watching ahead for danger.

questions.question: What should the Scout do before moving the party forward?
questions.correctExplanation: The Scout checks for danger before moving the party forward.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Scout should check for danger before moving the party forward.

questions.question: What do you do when the person you are watching gets attacked?
questions.correctExplanation: You protect the person you are watching. The person watching you will take your target.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should protect the person you are watching instead of finishing your own monster.

questions.question: What do you do when the Vanguard member gets attacked?
answers: Protect them and attack their attacker
questions.correctExplanation: Protect the Vanguard member and attack the enemy attacking them.
questions.wrongExplanation: When the Vanguard is attacked, protect them and attack their attacker.

questions.question: Should you watch the person assigned to you?
questions.correctExplanation: You should always watch the party member assigned to you.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should watch your assigned party member at all times, not only when they are dying.

questions.question: Why do party members watch each other?
questions.correctExplanation: Party members watch each other so they can protect one another.
questions.wrongExplanation: The purpose is to protect each other, not to compete for kills.

questions.question: What should you do if your assigned person is in danger?
questions.correctExplanation: Assist the party member you are responsible for watching.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should assist your assigned party member when they are in danger.

questions.question: When is concentrated fire performed?
questions.correctExplanation: Concentrated fire is used when fighting in pairs.
questions.wrongExplanation: Concentrated fire is performed when party members are fighting in pairs.

questions.question: When fighting in pairs, who should you attack?
answers: The same target as your partner
questions.correctExplanation: Both partners attack the same target.
questions.wrongExplanation: Partners should attack the same target.

questions.question: Why use concentrated fire?
questions.correctExplanation: Concentrated fire defeats targets faster by combining damage.
questions.wrongExplanation: The purpose is to combine damage and defeat targets faster.

questions.question: Should paired players attack separate targets?
questions.correctExplanation: Yes if no one is being attacked.
questions.wrongExplanation: Paired players should concentrate their attacks on the same target.

questions.question: What happens when everyone concentrates on one target?
questions.correctExplanation: Concentrating attacks causes the target to go down faster.
questions.wrongExplanation: Concentrated fire makes the target go down faster.

questions.question: Combat, Healer can decide to call the Wagon Wheel formation?
answers: Any time, it is there write
questions.correctExplanation: The Healer can if they need to stop and heal.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Healer decides only when there is a need

questions.question: What is the Wagon Wheel formation used for?
questions.correctExplanation: The Wagon Wheel creates a protective formation around the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Wagon Wheel is used to protect the party from attacks.

questions.question: In a Wagon Wheel, should party members watch their assigned person?
questions.correctExplanation: Each party member watches their assigned person.
questions.wrongExplanation: Party members must watch their assigned person.

questions.question: What does the Wagon Wheel create around the party?
questions.correctExplanation: The Wagon Wheel creates a protective circle around the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: The formation creates a protective circle, not a straight line.

questions.question: Should everyone in the Wagon Wheel watch for attacks?
questions.correctExplanation: Healer and scout have different jobs
questions.wrongExplanation: Everyone participates in watching for attacks, not only the Titan.

questions.question: Who can decide to retreat when someone goes down?
questions.correctExplanation: The Healer decides whether to resurrect or retreat.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Healer makes the decision to resurrect or retreat.

questions.question: What does the Healer decide when someone is down?
answers: Resurrect or retreat to save the party
questions.correctExplanation: The Healer decides whether to resurrect the fallen member or retreat to save the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: The Healer decides between resurrection and retreat to protect the remaining party.

questions.question: If retreat is called, what do you do?
answers: Form the retreat formation and pull back together
Keep fighting until you are in the rear
questions.correctExplanation: Everyone forms the retreat formation and pulls back together.
questions.wrongExplanation: When retreat is called, form the retreat formation and pull back together.

questions.question: Should you stay and fight alone after retreat is called?
questions.correctExplanation: Once retreat is called, everyone pulls back together.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should not stay and fight alone after retreat is called.

questions.question: Why might the Healer call a retreat?
questions.correctExplanation: The Healer may call a retreat to save the remaining party.
questions.wrongExplanation: A retreat is called to save the remaining party, not to get more kills.

questions.question: If a party member is down, should everyone keep fighting?
answers: No, the Healer decides whether to resurrect or retreat
questions.correctExplanation: The Healer decides whether to resurrect the fallen member or retreat.
questions.wrongExplanation: The party should follow the Healer's decision to resurrect or retreat.

questions.question: When retreating, should the party stay together?
questions.correctExplanation: The party retreats together as a group.
questions.wrongExplanation: Everyone should retreat together rather than running separately.

questions.question: Should you pull extra mobs toward the party?
questions.correctExplanation: Do not pull extra mobs toward the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: Pulling extra mobs toward the party creates unnecessary danger.

questions.question: Should you attack a new target without reason?
questions.correctExplanation: Stay with the party's target unless there is a reason to change.
questions.wrongExplanation: Do not attack a new target without a reason.

questions.question: What should you do when the party changes targets?
questions.correctExplanation: Follow the party's concentrated fire onto the new target.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should follow the party's concentrated fire rather than continuing on the old target.

questions.question: Should you leave the formation to chase a mob?
questions.correctExplanation: Stay in formation and do not chase mobs away from the party.
questions.wrongExplanation: Do not leave the formation to chase a mob.

questions.question: What should you do if you see danger?
questions.correctExplanation: Warn the party so everyone knows about the danger.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should warn the party when you see danger.

questions.question: Should party members communicate when danger appears?
questions.correctExplanation: Communication helps the party react to danger together.
questions.wrongExplanation: Party members should communicate when danger appears.

questions.question: Should you run ahead of the Scout?
questions.correctExplanation: The Scout checks ahead for danger, so you should not run ahead.
questions.wrongExplanation: Do not run ahead of the Scout.

questions.question: Should everyone attack the same target when concentrated fire is called?
questions.correctExplanation: Everyone should concentrate on the same target.
questions.wrongExplanation: When concentrated fire is called, everyone attacks the same target.

questions.question: What should you do if your target dies?
answers: Run off looking for another enemy
questions.correctExplanation: Assist the party by moving to its next target.
questions.wrongExplanation: Do not run off looking for another enemy. Assist the party's next target.

questions.question: Should you chase an enemy away from the party?
questions.correctExplanation: Stay with the party and do not chase enemies away.
questions.wrongExplanation: Do not chase an enemy away from the party.

questions.question: What is more important than getting the killing blow?
questions.correctExplanation: Keeping the party safe is more important than getting the killing blow.
questions.wrongExplanation: Keeping the party safe is more important than getting the most kills.

questions.question: Should you protect your assigned party member?
questions.correctExplanation: Protecting your assigned party member is one of the core party rules.
questions.wrongExplanation: You should protect your assigned party member without waiting for them to ask.
